estimand.null: zero population mean for every tested raw effect row
estimand.statistic: maximum absolute one-sample t across target parcels and the jointly tested contrast family
estimand.unadjusted_rejection: at least one coordinate-wise randomization p <= 0.05
estimand.effect_bias: mean and mean absolute group map under the null

raw_sign_action: For each subject, multiply every tested raw beta row by one common subject sign, leave nuisance rows, geometry, masses, designs, kernel, and independent alignment replicate fixed, then refit every beta-dependent quantity in the full-reestimation arm.
grid_design: Deterministic fractional/OAT grid in court.R; every named factor varies while keeping full re-estimation computationally identifiable.

pilot_budget_rule.order: Run full_permutation_reestimation first on the pilot cell.
pilot_budget_rule.selection: Choose the largest n_sim*n_perm whose predicted four-worker full-reestimation wall time across the six exact-oracle cells is at most the fixed formal wall budget; ties prefer larger n_sim. The minimum n_sim is 40 because with 24 simulations even zero rejections has a Wilson upper bound above the frozen 0.12 negative-control gate. If the minimum exceeds budget, run the minimum and label the court resource-limited rather than weakening gates.

mapper_solver.family: entropic Sinkhorn for non-reference subjects; the current identity-special-cased reference is retained as a diagnosed legacy behavior in this early court
mapper_solver.failure_policy: record nonconvergence; do not retune epsilon, tolerance, or iteration cap after formal results
mapper_solver.pilot_refinements: v0 identified an unfrozen overly strict tolerance; v1 showed that 2000 iterations violated the predeclared 5% solver gate. Both pilots and seeds are retained. The final pre-formal policy uses package-standard tolerance 1e-4 and 5000 iterations.

formal_gates.negative_control: geometry_only and independent_alignment each require a Wilson 95% interval containing 0.05 and upper bound <= 0.12
formal_gates.exact_oracle: full_permutation_reestimation requires a Wilson 95% interval containing 0.05; otherwise the candidate is invalid
formal_gates.inflation_flag: a same-data arm is materially inflated when its Wilson lower bound exceeds 0.05 and its point estimate exceeds 0.10
formal_gates.solver_gate: more than 5% nonconverged or failed mappings invalidates that cell
formal_gates.latent_span_model: Regress excess rejection and operator sensitivity on 1/(S*relative_eigengap); never summarize the residual dependence as uniformly O(1/S).

stopping_rule: Run the frozen budget for every scheduled cell. Stop only for the solver gate, non-finite statistics, or the fixed wall/resource ceiling; retain all completed seeds and label the result incomplete. Do not replace seeds, delete adverse cells, weaken thresholds, or increase epsilon after observing results.

promotion_language.independent: May be called inferentially eligible only if its negative-control gate passes.
promotion_language.geometry_only: Ancillary correspondence bound, not evidence that functional alignment works.
promotion_language.same_data: Always approximate under rank truncation, even if observed size is favorable.
promotion_language.full_reestimation: Exact same-data reference only for the frozen raw sign action and DGP scope.
promotion_language.later_work: FA-5 through FA-8 inherit these labels and may not be promoted on power alone.
